player_prompt.intro: Ị na-egwu {color} n'egwuregwu nke Breakthrough. Ị na-agagharị {direction} na {board_size}x{board_size} board. Na gị n'aka ị nwere ike ịkwaga otu iberibe otu nzọụkwụ n'ihu ma ọ bụ diagonally n'ihu. A iberibe nwere ike naanị ịkwaga diagonally ma ọ bụrụ na onye iro iberibe bụ n'ebe ahụ, na naanị ịkwaga n'ime ndị dị otú ahụ a na-echegbu square na a diagonal nzọụkwụ. Mgbe na-abanye n'ime a square na onye iro iberibe, ị weghara ya na onye iro iberibe na-ewepụ kpamkpam si board. Jiri UCI-dị ka notation na brackets, eg [a2a3] ịkwaga a2 ka a3. * 'a' kwekọrọ na n'aka ekpe kọlụm, '1' bụ ala n'ahịrị (site na White si ele ihe anya). * Black si n'ụlọ bụ n'elu ahịrị (ahịrị 8 maka 8x8). White si n'ụlọ bụ n'ahịrị (ahịrị 1 maka 8x8). Ọ bụrụ na onye ọkpụkpọ nke mbụ ruru n'ụlọ onye iro gị, ị na-enweta mmeribe niile.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Biko jiri akara algebraic dị ka [a2a3].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Ịgagharị agagharị abụghị ihe a na-eme n'ebe ahụ.
invalid_move.illegal: Nke ahụ anaghị agbaso iwu nke Ịgbapụta ma ọ bụ na ọ bụghị ihe ị na-eme.

outcome.white_reached: Ndị ọcha ruru n'ahịrị ebe ndị ojii na-agba.
outcome.black_reached: Ndị isi ojii ruru n'ahịrị ebe ndị ọcha na-agba.
outcome.white_captured: A na-ejide ihe niile ndị ọcha na-eme.
outcome.black_captured: A na-ejide ihe nile ndị isi ojii na-eme.
